results.note: Behaviour change real: closed generic CLASS from metadata with an unkeyed member: base reported MsgPack004 twice (Location.None), head reports nothing. Gemini's stated mechanism ('previously threw') is WRONG: base reported, it did not throw.

Base analyzer reported MsgPack004 with Location.None and no AD0001/exception, so location-less diagnostics are accepted; the code comment 'analyzers are not permitted to report against a location that does not exist' overstates (that is true for locations in a foreign syntax tree, not Location.None). The filter drops Location.None diagnostics too.

Positional record `[property: Key((string)null)] int V`: base crashes (AD0001 InvalidCastException), head reports only MsgPack007 and silently omits the MsgPack005 that the equivalent class (G1) and body-property record (G5) get. A SOURCE-declared type loses its correct diagnostic (loud crash became silent omission). Claude's H1 probe had no such case.
